This is a configuration/type system issue that can be verified without building or running the code. The error messages are clear (TS18042 and TS2693), and the issue is about TypeScript's interpretation of the package structure and exports field. 

To verify any solution to this issue, one would only need to modify the package.json configuration or the TypeScript declaration files and then run the TypeScript compiler in check mode (as shown in the reproduction steps with `npx tsc --noEmit --checkJs`). This doesn't require actually building and running the application - it's just checking if TypeScript accepts the code without errors.

The solution would likely involve adjusting the exports field in package.json or modifying how the types are declared in the .d.ts file, which can be verified by simply running the TypeScript compiler in check mode to see if the errors disappear.
